claims.claim: This is a girst grade Tokumbo tires
claims.evidence: Witness photos show tread/sidewall close-ups, but brand/model is not fully readable (only partial “MAX…”). No DOT/date code or origin proof is shown.

claims.claim: will last almost like new brand ones
claims.evidence: Photos show tread pattern/grooves, but remaining tread depth (measured), age (DOT), and wear uniformity are not provided.
This is a sales prompt; it does not provide verifiable product condition details.

risks.risk: Exact tire size (width/aspect ratio/rim diameter) and load/speed rating are unknown, which can make the tire unusable or unsafe for the buyer’s vehicle
risks.proof: A clear photo of the full sidewall text including the full size (e.g., 205/55R16) and load/speed rating (e.g., 91V), plus a shot showing the entire sidewall lettering in one frame.
risks.if_unproven: Price as an unknown-size used tire (worst-case fit/compatibility risk).

risks.risk: Brand/model identity is not fully readable; could be a different make than claimed
risks.proof: A close-up photo where the full brand and model name are readable (not partial “MAX…”), ideally with the entire sidewall visible.
risks.if_unproven: Price as generic/unknown brand used tire.

risks.risk: Tire age (DOT date code) is not shown; older tires can fail sooner even if tread looks deep
risks.proof: A photo showing the DOT code clearly (week/year) on the sidewall.
risks.if_unproven: Price as older used tires (higher risk of aging/cracking).

risks.risk: Remaining tread depth is not measured; deep grooves in photos may not equal safe tread depth
risks.proof: A measured tread depth reading (in mm) at multiple points (center and shoulders) shown in a short clip or photo with a tread gauge.
risks.if_unproven: Price as lower tread/unknown tread depth used tires.

risks.risk: Damage/repairs are not shown (cuts, bulges, cracks, bead damage, patches); these can be hidden from close tread shots
risks.proof: Full tire inspection photos: both sidewalls, bead area, and tread from multiple angles; include any repair/patch areas and a close-up of any suspected cracks/cuts.
risks.if_unproven: Price as potentially damaged/unknown condition used tire.

risks.risk: Quantity and whether it’s a full set is unknown; mismatched tires can reduce safety and value
risks.proof: A photo showing all tires available laid out together, with quantity clearly visible.
risks.if_unproven: Price per single tire (or worst-case incomplete set).

risks.risk: Whether it holds air is unknown; some used tires may leak or have valve/bead issues
risks.proof: A short clip showing the tire inflated and holding air (or a pressure check reading), plus a close-up of the valve stem.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not confirmed to hold air (worst-case needs repair).

proof_requests: Send a clear photo of the full sidewall showing the complete size and load/speed rating.
Send a photo where the full brand/model name is fully readable (not partial “MAX…”).
Send a photo of the DOT date code (week/year) clearly.
Provide measured tread depth (mm) at center and both shoulders, ideally with a tread gauge.
Send full inspection photos of both sidewalls, bead area, and tread from multiple angles (including any cracks/cuts/bulges/repairs).
Confirm quantity available (single tire vs full set) with a photo showing all tires.
Show proof it holds air: a short clip of inflation/pressure reading and a close-up of the valve stem.
response.reason: The witness confirms it is a car tire with tread pattern, but key pricing drivers (exact size/ratings, brand/model, DOT age, measured tread depth, and damage/air-holding) are missing or not readable. Without those, a worst-case price would be unreliable.
